0022600040.text: The San Antonio Spurs (10-2, 1st in the Southwest) host the Golden State Warriors (8-4, 6th in the West) in Emirates NBA Cup West Group C play, with the Spurs riding a 10-game win streak and a 6-0 road record, while the Warriors have won eight of their last ten and are coming off a loss. San Antonio will be without Devin Vassell (groin), Jayden Quaintance (knee surgery), and Tobias Harris (calf strain), and Golden State will be without Brandon Williams (hamstring), Gary Payton II (knee inflammation), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee surgery), with Stephen Curry listed as day-to-day with abdomen soreness and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and they split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, with the Spurs winning the most recent meeting 127-113 in San Francisco on April 1, 2026.
